fields.description: Either a NedBank NedFleet "Vehicle Audit Trail" statement or a Standard Bank "Extended Vehicle Transaction Report" — the format is detected automatically from the file's own content (see Detected Format below). Locked once this import is submitted.
fields.label: Statement File

fields.description: Not Parsed: no file attached yet. Missing Information: file parsed, and either nothing or only some of it resolves to a known Fleet Card. Pending Import: everything resolves, ready for Start Import. Importing: the background job is running. Partially Imported: the background job finished, but some rows were still unresolved — resolve the remaining Issues (pick a Fleet Card for each) and Start Import again. Completed: fully resolved and submitted. Error: the last import attempt failed — see Import Log for why.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:

fields.description: Which known statement shape the attached file was recognised as — see engineering.controllers.fleet_card_import_parsers.sniff_format(). Blank until the file is parsed.
fields.label: Detected Format

fields.description: How many rows in the file resolve to a known Fleet Card right now. Start Import only ever refuses when this is zero — otherwise it imports whatever's ready and leaves the rest in Issues below for a later pass.
fields.label: Rows Ready Now

fields.description: Card numbers/registrations in this file that couldn't be matched to a Fleet Card. Resolve each one in the Issues table below to clear this.
fields.label: Unmatched Cards

fields.description: Every card in the file that couldn't be matched to a Fleet Card. Pick the Fleet Card for each row and save — this only affects re-running Start Import on this document, it is not written back to the Fleet Card itself. Submitting is blocked while any issue remains unresolved.
fields.label: Issues
Created Transactions

fields.description: How many times the stalled-import watchdog has automatically re-queued this document in a row — reset to 0 by any deliberate, human-triggered Start Import. Reaching the retry cap flips this to "Error" instead of queuing it again.
fields.label: Stall Recovery Attempts
